proves.claim: A red receipt of the main-wide test job queued after a sprint landing, posted through boardJobQueueCall, reopens the sprint item its land job landed through the store reopen writer, so the reopen table row pull-out-red writes a pull_out naming the failing case and the merge commit.

api.gate.post-land-red.pull-out-red-fire.why: A test a sprint landing broke on main must send the landed work back and start its pull-out without a hand step.

proves.claim: A green receipt of the main-wide test job leaves the landed sprint item submitted and merged, with no reopen and no pull_out.

api.gate.post-land-red.green-changes-not.why: Only a red main-wide run may pull landed work out.

proves.claim: A steady landing queues no main-wide test job, and a plain test job receipt applies with no post-land board call.

api.gate.post-land-red.steady-unchanged.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady landings or other test jobs.
